svg.text: Hair/head fit matrix · true profile correction v5.1
REVIEW ONLY · every style fitted to every head · south/east at literal 48 px · east silhouette repeated at 40 px
The same hair family changes crown width and profile reach with the head; east mass must stop before the face and sit behind the skull.
